content.rendered:
Ludhiana is Punjab's industrial engine and India's MSME capital in many ways — bicycles and cycle parts (Hero, Avon and hundreds of ancillaries), hosiery and knitwear, machine tools, hand tools, auto parts, sewing machines and steel forging, packed into Focal Point, Dhandari Kalan and Industrial Areas A and B. Thousands of these units run production floors that need compact, durable admin and dispatch cabins. SAMAN is a container office manufacturer, not a marketplace reseller; as a Container Office Manufacturer for Ludhiana Industry we build steel units and dispatch them from our Greater Noida factory — direct, with no local resale markup. This page covers what Ludhiana buyers ask before they order.

Who buys container offices in Ludhiana

Bicycle and cycle-parts units use them as production-floor supervisor and dispatch cabins. Hosiery and knitwear units use them as admin, sampling and accounts cabins. Machine-tool, hand-tool and forging units use them as QC and project offices. Steel and logistics operators at Dhandari Kalan use them as gate and documentation cabins. Builders on Ludhiana's growing commercial and infrastructure projects use them as construction site offices. The common need is a rugged, compact unit that arrives finished and fits a busy MSME plot.

Ludhiana industrial zones we deliver to

We dispatch across the city's main industrial belts:

  • Focal Point, Phases I–VIII (141010) — Ludhiana's flagship industrial estate; cycle parts, machine tools, auto parts and engineering; supervisor, admin and project cabins.
  • Dhandari Kalan (141010) — the steel, forging, fabrication and logistics belt on the eastern side; gate, dispatch and documentation cabins.
  • Industrial Area A & B (141003) — the older hosiery, knitwear and cycle-parts belt; compact admin and sampling cabins.
  • Sherpur MSME belt — near Focal Point; warehousing and small-unit site offices.

Sites outside these pockets — Bahadurke Road, Gill Road or along the Chandigarh road — are also served; share the location when you enquire and we will confirm transport.

Container office sizes and specifications

A SAMAN container office is a fabricated steel structure, not a repainted shipping box. The frame uses mild steel sections to IS 2062, panelled and finished in our factory so the unit lands ready to use. Typical configurations:

SizeFootprint (approx)Typical use in Ludhiana
10 ft10 × 8 ftSecurity/gate cabin, single-desk supervisor post
20 ft20 × 8 ftProduction-floor admin, sampling or dispatch cabin
40 ft40 × 8 ftMulti-desk project office, office + store combined

For units that move between plots or sites we can supply a mobile container office for multi-site MSMEs. Typical build (final specification confirmed at quotation):

  • Frame: MS sections to IS 2062, welded, anchor-bolt ready
  • Walls: PUF / rockwool sandwich panel or cement board, insulated
  • Roof: galvanised / GI profile sheet with slope for drainage
  • Floor: ply base with vinyl or IPS finish
  • Openings: powder-coated door(s) and windows with grills and shutters
  • Electricals: MCB distribution board, internal points, lights and fan provision

Customisation options

Most Ludhiana orders are customised to the plot and the use. We can add: partition walls for separate cabins; AC provision and added insulation for admin and sampling use; toilet and pantry blocks; additional windows or a glazed front; dispatch-window layouts for logistics and forging units; and ramps or external steps. Compact 10 ft and 20 ft units suit tight MSME plots. Tell us the team size, the plot conditions and whether the unit moves between sites, and we configure accordingly.

Delivery and installation in Ludhiana

We manufacture near Greater Noida and dispatch to Ludhiana by road, around 400 km via NH-44 through Panipat and Ambala — a fast, well-established corridor. Transit is typically 3–5 days once the unit is ready, and a default delivery charge of ₹3,000 applies where relevant, with final transport confirmed by site distance and access. Smaller units are craned or forklifted into place in one visit; 40 ft units need clear offloading access, so confirm gate width and crane room when you enquire. We serve container office delivery for Delhi sites on the same northern network, so the route into Punjab is well established.

Why buy from SAMAN

SAMAN POS India Pvt Ltd has manufactured prefab steel structures since 2009 (incorporated 2019), with 500+ projects delivered. We work to ISO 9001:2015 (E20250218645), ISO 14001:2015 (E20250218646) and ISO 45001:2018 (E20250218647), and are registered with NSIC (NSIC/GP/BAN/2024/0055207) and DPIIT (DIPP56005). GST (North): 09ABBCS7101B1ZT. Units carry a 5-year structural frame-and-base warranty plus 1–2 years on finishing, and are engineered for a 20–25 year service life. Because we fabricate in-house and dispatch direct, Ludhiana buyers deal with the manufacturer — not a local reseller adding a markup. We supply across North India, including container offices supplied to Jaipur and the Lucknow container office manufacturing page.

Price factors

We quote to specification rather than posting one sticker price, because the cost of a container office in Ludhiana depends on real variables: size (10/20/40 ft), panel and insulation type, partitioning, electricals, toilet/pantry additions, finish, and transport. Buying direct from the manufacturer avoids the local resale markup that marketplace listings often carry. We give an itemised quotation so you can compare like for like. Share your size and fit-out needs for an honest price. (7-day return applies, with return shipping borne by the customer.)

FAQs

How much does a container office cost in Ludhiana?

Price depends on size, insulation, partitions, electricals and fit-out. A bare 10 ft gate cabin and a fully fitted 40 ft project office sit far apart on cost — and buying direct from us avoids a reseller markup. We quote to your exact specification, so share your requirement for an itemised price.

Do you sell direct or through a Ludhiana dealer?

Direct. We are the manufacturer and dispatch from our own factory near Greater Noida, so you deal with us on specification, price and after-sales without a local resale markup.

What size suits a Ludhiana MSME factory admin or dispatch office?

For a compact plot, a 20 ft unit usually works well for admin, sampling or dispatch; a 10 ft suits a single supervisor or gate post; a 40 ft suits a larger project office. Tell us your team size and plot and we advise.

Can the container office be moved between sites later?

Yes. Container offices are relocatable. If you expect to shift the unit between plots or sites, tell us at order stage so we specify lifting points and a shell suited to repeated handling.

Call or Send an Enquiry

Call +91 87960 39938 or +91 97089 89937 to discuss your Ludhiana container office, or use Send Enquiry for a specification-based quotation.
